About This Project

This is a test website created to verify Vellum's ZIP project support.

It demonstrates:

  • ✅ ZIP extraction with complete folder structure
  • ✅ Relative path resolution across folders
  • ✅ CSS stylesheet loading from css/style.css
  • ✅ JavaScript execution from js/app.js
  • ✅ Image loading from images/test.png
  • ✅ Linking to pages in subfolders (pages/about.html)
  • ✅ Navigation between HTML files in the project

File Structure

website-project.zip
├── index.html
├── css/
│   └── style.css
├── js/
│   └── app.js
├── images/
│   └── test.png
└── pages/
    └── about.html

How It Works

When you upload a ZIP file to Vellum:

  1. The ZIP is extracted entirely in the browser using JSZip
  2. index.html is found and used as the entry point
  3. All relative paths are resolved to extracted files
  4. Blob URLs are created for each asset
  5. The complete website is reconstructed and previewed
  6. The entire project is saved in IndexedDB

Test Results

Open the browser console (F12) to see test output from js/app.js

Check that:

  • CSS styling is applied (purple gradient background)
  • Images display correctly
  • JavaScript console logs show successful file loading
  • Navigation links work between pages
